title: Gudanar da tashoshin ku da kyau kuma ku sami riba ta gaskiya a kowane

say: Gudanar da tashoshin ku da kyau, kuma ku sami riba ta gaskiya a kowane ɗayan.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo na module 2: Tashoshi Ayyuka, inganci da Gaskiya Margin.
Oda-zuwa tsabar kuɗi ita ce cikakkiyar hanya daga lokacin da abokin tarayya ya ba da oda zuwa lokacin da kuɗin ke cikin aminci a cikin asusun kasuwancin ku.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Kasuwanci yana ƙarewa lokacin da aka rubuta kuɗin
items: Order-to-cash: daga oda zuwa kudi a cikin asusunka

say: Lokacin da kowane mataki ba a bayyana ba, umarni ya ɓace, ana gardama kan isar da kuɗi kuma ana manta da daftari. Ana gama siyar da kuɗin ne kawai lokacin da aka rubuta kuɗin, ba lokacin da motar ta tashi ba.

say: Tashar na iya kawo manyan tallace-tallace kuma har yanzu rasa ku kuɗi. Don haka fara daga farashin shiryayye kuma tafiya baya.

Dillalin yana adana 30% na 4,000, wanda shine 1,200, don haka yana biyan 2,800. Wannan kashi 30% shine gefe, rabon farashin siyarwa. Ana ƙara alama zuwa farashi. Koyaushe tambayi wanda abokin tarayya yake nufi.
Mai rarrabawa yana adana 280 daga cikin 2,800, kuma yana biyan Amaka 2,520.
Kudinta 1,900 ne, don haka sai ta ajiye naira 620 a kowace kwalba.
Bayan kudade, bayarwa, tallace-tallace da kwamitocin, tallace-tallace kai tsaye da wakili suna barin mafi yawan kowace kwalba, kuma mai rarrabawa kadan.

panel.heading: Riba kowace kwalba ko riba a wata

say: Amma mai rabon zai iya kwashe kwalba 300 duk wata, akan naira 186,000, babu talla ko hira. Tallace-tallacen kai tsaye sun makale a oda 100 suna ba da 164,000. Don haka kwatanta jimlar ribar wata-wata, lokacin ku da ƙarfin ku.

panel.heading: Riba kowace kwalba ko riba a wata

say: Don tunawa. Rubuta gajeriyar tsarin yau da kullun don kowane tashoshi, kuma kiyaye oda guda ɗaya da rajistar biyan kuɗi waɗanda kuke bincika kowane mako. Ƙirga tsarin kuɗin ku. Yi rikodin kowane tsari kuma juya hannun jari. Kuma ku yi hukunci a kan kowane tashar akan ribar sa ta gaskiya a kowane wata, ba akan tallace-tallace kadai ba.
